items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: me and David played for J.K.

ctx.x: What about playing though. I mean you started …

Yeah, right around Dallas there was people like David Newman who we were in high school together and we would have jam sessions and I would be invited. I was a little younger than them, David and his generation. But I was invited because I was a Walton kid from down the street. [laughs] Give him a shot, you know, and they would see how happy I was, how hungry I was to uh, be a part of this movement.
Who was that circle? Give us some more of the …
